messages:
zoe: Proposal 
: run a 10-day "Community Refkit Sprint" focused on tiny tutorials, an opinionated benchmark story, and a single webinar. KPI: 60 signups, 45 bench submissions, 30 repo stars.
harry: thumbs up. keep friction low: 3 tutorial posts + 1 benchmark notebook + short demo video. CTA: 'Run the bench, paste your results'.
mina: leadflow: HubSpot form with fields name|email|github|team_size|region|bench_url|utm_campaign. tag leads `community_sprint_1716`. then slice for submitters to a nurture list.
zoe: content plan: Day 0 landing & blog post with benchmark narrative, Days 1-7 tutorials drip, Day 8 webinar (live run + Q&A), Day 9 recap + highlights.
harry: benchmark specifics in docs: `python run_bench.py --model redwood-small --seq 256 --batch 8 --cpu` -> results.json schema. we'll provide a paste form and optional webhook.
mina: analytics: UTM `refkit_sprint_1716`. dashboard funnel: visit->signup->bench submitted->webinar attend->followup. assign GA events and a HubSpot workflow.
zoe: assets request: hero gif (demo start), 3 social cards, and a short 60s demo clip. design drop by Wed.
harry: messaging test: Variant A (product): "Measure latency & cost with Refkit"; Variant B (community): "Ship a tiny refapp and show us what you built". split 60/40 to push the community angle.
ops-bot: Reminder: staging landing must be live at 1716230000 for QA.
mina: owners: zoe=launch, harry=tech content & repo, mina=lead routing & analytics. sync Fri 9am PT. keep thread for action items only. :rocket:
